They are mostly found in mandragor groups that suddenly [[popup]] as you approach them. In [[Kourna]], some of them are always visible, but as you approach, other mandragors will popup. ==Locations== *[[Istan]] **{{NPC location|Cliffs of Dohjok}} (level 8, only during [[Quarry Quandry]] and [[Queen of the Quarry]]) **{{NPC location|Plains of Jarin}} (level 3) **{{NPC location|Lahtenda Bog}} (level 12) **{{NPC location|Mehtani Keys}} (level 12) **{{NPC location|Zehlon Reach}} (level 12) *[[Kourna]] (level 22) **{{NPC location|Arkjok Ward}} **{{NPC location|Bahdok Caverns}} **{{NPC location|Barbarous Shore}} **{{NPC location|Jahai Bluffs}} **{{NPC location|Sunward Marches}} **{{NPC location|The Floodplain of Mahnkelon}} ==Missions== *Kourna **{{NPC location|Moddok Crevice}} ==Skills== ===Istan, level 3 (22)=== *{{skill icon|Blood of the Aggressor}} *{{skill icon|Ravenous Gaze}} ([[elite]], hard mode only) ===Istan, level 8 (24)=== {{Section-stub}} ===Istan, level 12 (24)=== 11 [[Blood Magic]] (20 Blood Magic in hard mode) *{{skill icon|Chilblains}} *{{skill icon|Plague Touch}} *{{skill icon|Ravenous Gaze}} (elite, hard mode only) *{{skill icon|Signet of Agony}} ===Kourna=== 15 Blood Magic, 11 Soul Reaping *{{skill icon|Chilblains}} *{{skill icon|Plague Touch}} *{{skill icon|Ravenous Gaze}} (elite) *{{skill icon|Signet of Agony}} ==Armor ratings== ===Kourna=== {{NPC statistics | level = 22 | prof = n | blunt = 66 | piercing = 66 | slashing = 66 | cold = 66 | earth = 66 | fire = 66 | lightning = 66 }} ==Items dropped== *[[Luminous Stone]] (Kourna) *[[Lustrous Stone]] (Istan) *[[Mandragor Carapace]] (level 3 & 8) *[[Mandragor Root]] (level 22) *[[Mandragor Swamproot]] (level 12) ==Trivia== *There is a [[miniature]] version of the [[Miniature Mandragor Imp|Mandragor Imp]].
